sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些未经排练、毫无保留的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 上对部分精选采访进行现场直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barber.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴伯。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Twin Falls, Idaho was a typical American town.
sentences.zh: 今天，爱达荷州的特温福尔斯原本是一个典型的美国小镇。

sentences.en: Then, at the height of the presidential election, rumors surrounding a brutal local crime simmered to a boil and turned the whole town upside down.
sentences.zh: 然而，在总统大选白热化之际，围绕一起当地恶性犯罪事件的谣言开始持续发酵并彻底颠覆了整个小镇。

sentences.en: A fake news story and its real-life consequences.
sentences.zh: 一则假新闻及其在现实生活中引发的后果。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 27 日，星期三。

sentences.en: So the first that the mayor or anybody else in city government gets wind of anything is at a city council meeting.
sentences.zh: 因此，市长或市议会的其他任何人听到任何风吹草动，都是在一次市议会会议上。

sentences.en: For those of you wishing to join us, please rise for the Pledge of Allegiance.
sentences.zh: 对于希望加入我们的各位，请起立进行效忠宣誓。

sentences.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我效忠美利坚合众国的国旗。

sentences.en: They take place on Monday nights.
sentences.zh: 这些会议在每周一晚上举行。

sentences.en: They're in a small auditorium.
sentences.zh: 地点在一个小礼堂里。

sentences.en: Usually half a dozen people show up.
sentences.zh: 通常会有六七个人出席。

sentences.en: Caitlin Dickerson covers immigration for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·迪克森为《时报》报道移民问题。

sentences.en: And they end up talking about, like, lawn-watering schedules and ribbon-cutting.
sentences.zh: 他们最后讨论的往往是浇草坪的时间表和剪彩之类的事情。

sentences.en: We do have a quorum of the city council in attendance this evening.
sentences.zh: 今晚出席会议的市议员人数确实达到了法定人数。

sentences.en: So just like any other Monday night, the city council meeting starts.
sentences.zh: 因此，就像其他任何一个周一晚上一样，市议会会议开始了。

sentences.en: So the first item is general public input, if there is anyone here from the public who wishes to address the council.
sentences.zh: 所以第一项议程是公众意见征询，如果有公众来到这里希望向议会陈述。

sentences.en: So somebody gets up.
sentences.zh: 于是有人站了起来。

sentences.en: He states his name.
sentences.zh: 他报了自已的名字。

sentences.en: Terrence Edwards, 172, Long Island.
sentences.zh: 特伦斯·爱德华兹，172 号，长岛。

sentences.en: Terry Edwards.
sentences.zh: 特里·爱德华兹。

sentences.en: I guess my concern is with the refugee situation we have in this community.
sentences.zh: 我想我关心的我们社区里的难民情况。

sentences.en: And then he starts to ask about a crime.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始询问一桩罪案。

sentences.en: We've been made aware of an assault of a minor child.
sentences.zh: 我们获悉发生了一起针对未成年儿童的攻击事件。

sentences.en: It's been indicated that the perpetrators were for Muslim youth.
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明肇事者是穆斯林青年。

sentences.en: He says there was a rape.
sentences.zh: 他说发生了一起强奸案。

sentences.en: I guess it was a rape.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一起强奸案。

sentences.en: He says Muslim youth were involved.
sentences.zh: 他说有穆斯林青年涉案。

sentences.en: And I think that there's a method of cover-up here in the community.
sentences.zh: 我认为社区里存在一种掩盖真相的做法。

sentences.en: I think it starts with the police department.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是从警察局开始的。

sentences.en: I think that they have their mouth zipped closed.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们把嘴闭得严严实实。

sentences.en: You know, another person got up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，另一个人站了起来。

sentences.en: My name is Heather Stroop.
sentences.zh: 我叫海瑟·斯特罗普。

sentences.en: Julie Roth, 2849 Rock Creek Road.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·罗斯，洛克克里克路 2849 号。

sentences.en: And then another person got up, I think at least half a dozen people.
sentences.zh: 接着又有人站起来，我想至少有六七个人。

sentences.en: I also have heard about a minor who was attacked.
sentences.zh: 我也听说有一个未成年人遭到袭击。

sentences.en: What's Twin Falls City doing about these people's concerns?
sentences.zh: 特温福尔斯市政府对这些人的关切在做些什么？

sentences.en: Because there's people who are legitimately scared.
sentences.zh: 因为有些人确实感到害怕。

sentences.en: I'd like to know if the city council knows where the youths were who perpetrated the crime.
sentences.zh: 我想知道市议会是否知道犯下罪行的那些年轻人去了哪里。

sentences.en: And you guys are hiding it.
sentences.zh: 而你们却在隐瞒。

sentences.en: They think that the city government is hiding what actually happened.
sentences.zh: 他们认为市政府在隐瞒实际发生的事情。

sentences.en: Why aren't we profiling Muslims?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不对穆斯林进行档案记录或甄别？

sentences.en: I'm not a racist or white supremacist, but there should be profilings.
sentences.zh: 我不是种族主义者或白人至上主义者，但应该进行甄别。

sentences.en: ISIS is here.
sentences.zh: ISIS 来了。

sentences.en: The Muslim Brotherhood is here.
sentences.zh: 穆斯林兄弟会来了。

sentences.en: My family isn't safe here.
sentences.zh: 我的家人在这里不安全。

sentences.en: And if you don't address it, there's going to be heck to pay.
sentences.zh: 如果你不解决这个问题，将会有严重的后果。

sentences.en: Thank you for sharing your comments and concerns this evening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们今晚分享的意见和关切。

sentences.en: And the mayor and the city council members have no idea what he's talking about.
sentences.zh: 而市长和市议会成员根本不知道他在说些什么。

sentences.en: I am not personally aware of that.
sentences.zh: 我个人并不知情。

sentences.en: But again, if there are specific allegations, I have not heard a news report about allegations.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，如果有具体的指控，我没有听过关于这些指控的新闻报道。

sentences.en: Is that typical?
sentences.zh: 这很典型吗？

sentences.en: Ma'am, we were caught totally flat-footed.
sentences.zh: 女士，我们完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: We didn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 我们什么也不知道。

sentences.en: And so I said, I don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，我不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: If there's been a crime committed, I'm hopeful that someone reported that to the police.
sentences.zh: 如果真的发生了犯罪，我希望有人向警方报案了。

sentences.en: And I will certainly follow up with them and make sure that occurred.
sentences.zh: 我肯定会跟进并确保此事已经发生。

sentences.en: Sean Barriger had been elected mayor of Twin Falls just six months earlier.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·巴里格尔在仅仅六个月前刚当选为特温福尔斯市长。

sentences.en: And then one of the last speakers gets up and waves this paper at us.
sentences.zh: 然后其中最后一位发言者站起来，向我们挥舞着这张纸。

sentences.en: And it is a printout of a news story that had run on the local newscaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是当地新闻广播中播出的一则新闻报道的打印件。

sentences.en: Idaho's First News has confirmed that a reported sexual assault around the Fondbrook apartments in Twin Falls is being investigated by the Twin Falls Police Department.
sentences.zh: 爱达荷第一新闻已证实，特温福尔斯警察局正在调查一起据报发生在该市方布鲁克公寓附近的性侵案。

sentences.en: But no one will comment officially on the case while it is still under investigation.
sentences.zh: 但在案件仍在调查期间，没有人会对此案发表官方评论。

sentences.en: So starting that night, you start to see blog posts pop up in places like Jihad Watch, like Refugee Resettlement Watch, Creeping Sharia, like the Muslim issue.
sentences.zh: 因此从那天晚上开始，你开始看到博客文章在诸如“圣战观察”、“难民安置观察”、“潜行沙利亚”、“穆斯林问题”之类的网站上涌现。

sentences.en: These are names of blogs that track refugee resettlement, that track the spread of Islam, and that oppose both.
sentences.zh: 这些是追踪难民安置、追踪伊斯兰教传播并反对这两者的博客名称。

sentences.en: And the headlines repeat this very scary set of facts.
sentences.zh: 而头条新闻则重复着这套极其可怕的事实。

sentences.en: Three Syrian refugees rape little girl at 9th Point in Idaho before urinating on her body.
sentences.zh: 三名叙利亚难民在爱达荷州 9 号点持刀强奸小女孩并在其尸体上小便。

sentences.en: Furious residents accuse Twin Falls City Council members of covering up the assault.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的居民指责特温福尔斯市议会成员掩盖袭击事件。

sentences.en: Then it starts to show up on local Fox News affiliates.
sentences.zh: 然后这开始出现在当地的福克斯新闻分支机构上。

sentences.en: Who in the media is focusing on this five-year-old girl in a rape case?
sentences.zh: 媒体里有谁在关注强奸案中的这个五岁女孩？

sentences.en: Idaho should be the clarion call of every suburban mom out there.
sentences.zh: 爱达荷州应该成为每一位郊区母亲的战斗号角。

sentences.en: It shows up on InfoWars.
sentences.zh: 它出现在了“战争电台”（InfoWars）上。

sentences.en: The victim was a young girl who was born premature in his less developed...
sentences.zh: 受害者是一个早产的年轻女孩，发育较不完全……

sentences.en: There are YouTube videos about it.
sentences.zh: 网上有关于它的 YouTube 视频。

sentences.en: The reason I'm obsessing over Islamic, Islamic, Islamic, Islamic, Islamic, Islamic, that's the big story here.
sentences.zh: 我之所以对伊斯兰、伊斯兰、伊斯兰、伊斯兰、伊斯兰、伊斯兰魂牵梦绕，这就是这里的大新闻。

sentences.en: This is exactly the kind of immigration that Donald Trump wants to halt and that we must halt.
sentences.zh: 这正是唐纳德·特朗普想要制止且我们必须制止的那种移民。

sentences.en: All of this is getting shared on Facebook, and so all of it's getting amplified.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都在 Facebook 上被分享，因此所有这些都在被放大。

sentences.en: These supposed city leaders would have the good people of Twin Falls believe there isn't any invasion of psychotic refugees gradually flooding the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些所谓的城市领导人竟然想让特温福尔斯善良的人们相信，根本没有什么精神失常的难民大军逐步涌入美国的入侵。

sentences.en: And I think the peak really is when it hits Drudge.
sentences.zh: 我认为当它登上德鲁吉报道（Drudge）时，热度真的达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: It's the main story, banner headline, Syrian refugees rape five-year-old girl at knife point in Idaho.
sentences.zh: 这是头条新闻，通栏大标题：叙利亚难民在爱达荷州持刀强奸五岁女孩。

sentences.en: But the problem is, none of those scary details turn out to be true.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，那些可怕的细节后来证明全都不是真的。

sentences.en: Which details were wrong in that reporting?
sentences.zh: 那篇报道中有哪些细节是错误的？

sentences.en: So there was no knife.
sentences.zh: 所以根本没有刀。

sentences.en: There were no Syrians involved in the crime.
sentences.zh: 犯罪中没有叙利亚人参与。

sentences.en: There were no Syrians who've ever been resettled in Twin Falls at all.
sentences.zh: 根本没有任何叙利亚人曾在特温福尔斯重新安置过。

sentences.en: This was not a gang rape.
sentences.zh: 这不是一起轮奸案。

sentences.en: And maybe most importantly, everybody here involved in this crime was a child, and that's a really big piece that was left out.
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的是，这里涉案的每个人都是小孩子，这是一个被漏掉的非常重要的部分。

sentences.en: The perception was that these were young men, young adults, or adults.
sentences.zh: 人们的看法是，这些是年轻人、年轻成年人或成年人。

sentences.en: Adult men who gang raped a five-year-old girl, when in fact the physical contact that took place was between a five-year-old girl and a seven-year-old boy.
sentences.zh: 成年男子轮奸了一名五岁女孩，而事实上发生身体接触的是一个五岁女孩和一个七岁男孩。

sentences.en: And that's quite different.
sentences.zh: 情况完全不同。

sentences.en: Very different.
sentences.zh: 大不相同。

sentences.en: From the way it was portrayed.
sentences.zh: 与当时被描述的方式截然不同。

sentences.en: So what actually happened in Twin Falls?
sentences.zh: 那么特温福尔斯到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happened there is hard to talk about because news organizations don't report on sexual assault cases, especially those involving minors,
sentences.zh: 那里发生的事情很难谈论，因为新闻机构不会报道性侵案件，尤其是涉及未成年人的案件，

sentences.en: and because these cases are kept private for a reason.
sentences.zh: 而且这些案件由于某种原因被严格保密。

sentences.en: But here is what we know legally.
sentences.zh: 但这是我们从法律层面了解到的情况。

sentences.en: Three children were found partially disrobed in a laundry room that was shared in an apartment complex where they live.
sentences.zh: 三个孩子被发现衣衫不整地待在他们居住的公寓大楼共用的洗衣房里。

sentences.en: It was a five-year-old girl and two boys who were refugees.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一个五岁女孩和两个难民男孩。

sentences.en: The boys were charged with lewd and lascivious behavior.
sentences.zh: 这两个男孩被控犯有猥亵行为。

sentences.en: That means inappropriate touching.
sentences.zh: 这意味着不当的身体接触。

sentences.en: And the seven-year-old is the one who's accused and was later convicted of having done this, right?
sentences.zh: 那个七岁男孩就是被指控并随后被判定犯有此罪的人，对吧？

sentences.en: There's a 10-year-old in the room who was shooting a cell phone video, and then a 14-year-old who was charged as an accessory whose cell phone was borrowed.
sentences.zh: 房间里还有一个十岁的孩子用手机拍摄了视频，还有一个十四岁的孩子因被借用手机而作为从犯被起诉。

sentences.en: So what you have to remember is that these cases, although they're tragic, they're disturbing, they're not entirely uncommon.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须记住，这些案件虽然具有悲剧性、令人不安，但并非完全罕见。

sentences.en: In Twin Falls alone, the police department there says that about half a dozen of them each year are prosecuted, where both the children and the accused in the cases are minors.
sentences.zh: 仅在特温福尔斯，当地警察局表示，每年大约有六起此类案件被起诉，其中儿童和被指控者都是未成年人。

sentences.en: They say that for very young kids, it's often motivated by a desire to explore, kind of playing doctor type thing.
sentences.zh: 他们说，对于极小的孩子来说，这往往是由探索的欲望驱动的，有点像玩医生游戏那种性质。

sentences.en: And as kids get older, a sexual component becomes part of it too.
sentences.zh: 而随着孩子们长大，性成分也开始成为其中的一部分。

sentences.en: It sounds like what you're saying is that as awful and unsettling as this case may be in some of its details, it's not all that unusual for kids to behave this way.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，尽管这个案件在某些细节上可能令人可怕和不安，但孩子们表现出这种行为并不是很不寻常。

sentences.en: So why did this story take off in the way that it did?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么这个故事会以这种方式迅速传开并引发轰动呢？

sentences.en: I think it took off because it involved refugees and because it came up in a moment where both locally and nationally, there was an incredible amount of tension, of fear,
sentences.zh: 我认为它之所以传开，是因为它涉及难民，而且它发生在一个无论在地方还是国家层面都存在惊人数量的紧张、恐惧的时刻，

sentences.en: of frustration pent up, and really a lot of people looking for a case that they could use as an example for why refugees should not come to the United States.
sentences.zh: 郁积的沮丧情绪，以及确实有很多人在寻找一个可以作为例子的案件，用来说明为什么不应该让难民来到美国。

sentences.en: The White House now says the United States is preparing to accept at least 10,000 Syrian refugees.
sentences.zh: 白宫现在表示，美国正准备接纳至少 1 万名叙利亚难民。

sentences.en: This is about a nine times increase over the number that was taken in this past fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 这比上一财年接收的数量增加了大约九倍。

sentences.en: So as the White House terms it, it's a significant ramping up.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如白宫所言，这是一个显著的增长势头。

sentences.en: The local newspaper reported that it expected that the majority of the refugees who would be resettled in the following year would be from Syria.
sentences.zh: 当地报纸报道称，预计次年重新安置的大多数难民将来自叙利亚。

sentences.en: And you remember this came at the height of a lot of national concern about members of ISIS being able to slip through the refugee resettlement program from Syria.
sentences.zh: 你还记得，这正值全国上下高度担忧 ISIS 成员能够通过叙利亚难民安置计划混入美国之际。

sentences.en: And then we cannot afford to talk around issues anymore.
sentences.zh: 然后我们再也不能绕过问题不谈了。

sentences.en: We have to address these issues head on.
sentences.zh: 我们必须正面解决这些问题。

sentences.en: I called for a ban after San Bernardino and was met with great scorn and anger.
sentences.zh: 我在圣贝纳迪诺事件后呼吁实施禁令，并遭遇了巨大的嘲讽和愤怒。

sentences.en: But now many are saying that I was right to do so.
sentences.zh: 但现在许多人说我当时那样做是对的。

sentences.en: And that is the backdrop for these city council meetings in Twin Falls that the mayor was leading.
sentences.zh: 这就是由市长领导的特温福尔斯市议会会议的背景。

sentences.en: We're talking about the Muslim influence.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论穆斯林的影响。

sentences.en: It's time to take our country back.
sentences.zh: 是时候夺回我们的国家了。

sentences.en: Embarrass yourself and embarrass this community.
sentences.zh: 丢你自己的脸，也丢这个社区的脸。

sentences.en: I would please ask for respect.
sentences.zh: 请大家保持尊重。

sentences.en: In the discussion of this issue here in these council chambers, emotions have run high on both sides of this dais.
sentences.zh: 在议会大厦讨论这个议题时，辩论双方的情绪都异常激昂。

sentences.en: How did the mayor try to get out ahead of this?
sentences.zh: 市长是如何试图抢先一步控制事态的？

sentences.en: And what was he doing to try to stop the spread of this fear?
sentences.zh: 他采取了什么行动来试图阻止这种恐惧的蔓延？

sentences.en: The mayor tries to separate fact from fiction.
sentences.zh: 市长试图将事实与虚构区分开来。

sentences.en: He tries to calm people down.
sentences.zh: 他试图让人冷静下来。

sentences.en: He and the other city officials are all really trying to tamp down these fears, many of which are not based in reality.
sentences.zh: 他和市里其他官员都在竭力平息这些恐惧，其中许多恐惧并非基于现实。

sentences.en: So the police chief also shows up.
sentences.zh: 于是警察局长也露面了。

sentences.en: No evidence that a knife was used.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明使用了刀具。

sentences.en: But all of these efforts really fuel the fire and fuel the concern even more.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些努力实际上火上浇油，进一步加剧了担忧。

sentences.en: Because in all of these statements, they have to acknowledge, they have to say, look,
sentences.zh: 因为在所有这些声明中，他们不得不承认，他们不得不说，听着，

sentences.en: we can't tell you exactly what happened inside the laundry room because this case involves children.
sentences.zh: 我们不能告诉你洗衣房里面具体发生了什么，因为这个案件涉及儿童。

sentences.en: And we've been barred from doing so by the judge.
sentences.zh: 法官已经禁止我们这样做。

sentences.en: You know, the newspaper ethically wouldn't report on something like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，报纸从职业道德出发也不会报道那样的事情。

sentences.en: The handling judge has sealed this case.
sentences.zh: 主审法官已经对本案进行保密查封。

sentences.en: Because of that and because of state laws that deals to juvenile offenders,
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，以及由于处理未成年犯罪者的州法律，

sentences.en: I as a chief or any law enforcement official really cannot comment any further in regards to that particular incident.
sentences.zh: 作为局长或任何执法官员，我真的无法就该特定事件发表任何进一步的评论。

sentences.en: And just that gray area, that question mark about what actually happened,
sentences.zh: 而正是那片灰色地带，关于到底发生了什么的问号，

sentences.en: it allowed people to capitalize on the lack of solid information by just filling in the blanks with outlandish details.
sentences.zh: 这让人们通过用离奇的细节填补空白，来利用确凿信息的缺失。

sentences.en: So believers in this story cannot be dissuaded.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个故事的信奉者是无法被说服放弃立场的。

sentences.en: And it sounds like the story lives on.
sentences.zh: 而且听起来这个故事还在继续流传。

sentences.en: It lives on and it continues to grow because it continues to be picked up by outlets with larger and larger and larger audiences.
sentences.zh: 它在流传，并且还在不断发酵，因为它不断被受众规模越来越大的媒体平台所关注。

sentences.en: What's going on with this horrific story out of Twin Falls.
sentences.zh: 双瀑镇这起骇人听闻的事件到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And one of the biggest outlets to pick up the story is Breitbart News, which at the time is being run by Steve Bannon.
sentences.zh: 关注这个故事的最大媒体平台之一是布赖特巴特新闻网，当时该网站由史蒂夫·班农掌管。

sentences.en: Every theme that is important in this presidential race is in this in the particular.
sentences.zh: 在这场总统竞选中至关重要的每一个主题，都体现在这个具体事件中。

sentences.en: You can tell the general.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出大局。

sentences.en: That's why we've got Lee Stranahan on the case.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们让李·斯特拉纳汉来跟进这个案子。

sentences.en: And he sends his lead investigative reporter, a guy named Lee Stranahan, to Twin Falls to cover this story.
sentences.zh: 他派出了自己的首席调查记者，一个名叫李·斯特拉纳汉的人，前往双瀑镇报道此事。

sentences.en: We get guys like Stranahan.
sentences.zh: 我们有斯特拉纳汉这样的人。

sentences.en: This guy's like a pit bull and we're going to let him off the chain.
sentences.zh: 这家伙就像一头斗牛犬，我们要解开他的链子放他出击。

sentences.en: And Lee embeds there.
sentences.zh: 李深入到了当地。

sentences.en: He stays there for months and he covers the story aggressively.
sentences.zh: 他在那里呆了数月，并进行了猛烈的追踪报道。

sentences.en: Who is this guy?
sentences.zh: 这家伙是谁？

sentences.en: Lee Stranahan is in his 50s, but he's actually relatively new to journalism.
sentences.zh: 李·斯特拉纳汉已经五十多岁了，但其实他对新闻界来说是个相对的新人。

sentences.en: He'd been living in California and working in television for many years and was a liberal.
sentences.zh: 他曾在加利福尼亚生活并从事电视工作多年，曾是一名自由派。

sentences.en: He voted for Barack Obama in 2008.
sentences.zh: 他在2008年投票给 了巴拉克·奥巴马。

sentences.en: He says he hated George Bush.
sentences.zh: 他说他恨乔治·布什。

sentences.en: In addition to working in TV, he also shot erotic photography.
sentences.zh: 除了从事电视工作，他还拍摄过情色摄影作品。

sentences.en: But at a certain point, he starts writing for the Huffington Post initially and meets Andrew Breitbart, who becomes his mentor and converts him to conservatism.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时候，他开始为《赫芬顿邮报》撰稿，并结识了安德鲁·布赖特巴特，后者成为了他的导师并将他转化为保守派。

sentences.en: He eventually offers Stranahan a job at Breitbart News, where he becomes an investigative reporter.
sentences.zh: 他最终在布赖特巴特新闻网给斯特拉纳汉提供了一份工作，他在那里成为了一名调查记者。

sentences.en: And then after Breitbart dies, Steve Bannon assumes a similar role at Breitbart, but also in Stranahan's life.
sentences.zh: 而在布赖特巴特去世后，史蒂夫·班农在布赖特巴特担任了类似的角色，同时也在斯特拉纳汉的生活中扮演了类似的角色。

sentences.en: So he was really interested in Islam,
sentences.zh: 所以他真的对伊斯兰教很感兴趣，

sentences.en: really interested in the issue of refugee resettlement and had covered it for Breitbart when he found out about the story in Twin Falls and decided he had to get a piece of it,
sentences.zh: 对难民安置问题非常感兴趣，并为布赖特巴特进行过相关报道，当时他发现了双瀑镇的故事，并决定自己也必须分一杯羹，

sentences.en: too.
sentences.zh: 加入进来。

sentences.en: This is a story that hits on a number of things, including the fact, let's face it, in this election, we are not running against Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 这是一个触及多个层面的故事，其中包括这样一个事实——让我们面对现实吧，在这场选举中，我们的竞争对手根本不是希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: We're running against the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 我们的对手是主流媒体。

sentences.en: His most explicitly stated goal in his stories while he was there was to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 他在当地报道时最明确表达的目标就是说出真相。

sentences.en: He repeated.
sentences.zh: 他反复强调。

sentences.en: He said that the city council and the local officials there were involved in a cover-up, and he was going to reveal what really happened.
sentences.zh: 他说市议会和当地官员参与了一场掩盖真相的阴谋，而他要揭露真相到底是怎么样的。

sentences.en: But he didn't tell the truth in the end.
sentences.zh: 但他最终并没有说出真相。

sentences.en: And it's a real question for people.
sentences.zh: 这对人们来说是一个真正的问题。

sentences.en: Why would the local authorities here, you know, is the mayor a big, you know, Sharia supporter?
sentences.zh: 为什么这里的当地当局……你知道的，难道市长是个狂热的沙里亚支持者吗？

sentences.en: That's what we're out here on the ground getting to, the reality, why this has happened.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们来到实地要搞清楚的现实，为什么会发生这种事。

sentences.en: Do you honestly think that it's possible that the mayor of Twin Falls is a Sharia supporter?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为双瀑镇市长有可能支持沙里亚法吗？

sentences.en: Or did you think that at the time?
sentences.zh: 或者你当时是这么想的？

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: I think I probably, if I said that, I probably followed up by saying no.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能……如果我那么说过，我后面大概补充了一句没有。

sentences.en: No, you just left it out there.
sentences.zh: 不，你当时就把它抛在那里了。

sentences.en: I mean, I'll play it for you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我会放给你听的。

sentences.en: I'll send it to you after we finish.
sentences.zh: 我们结束之后我发给你。

sentences.en: You just left it out there.
sentences.zh: 你当时就把它挂在那里了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd have to hear what it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，我得听听当时是怎么说的。

sentences.en: I've been very clear before I even went to Twin Falls.
sentences.zh: 我在去双瀑镇之前就已经非常明确了。

sentences.en: But let me just say something about the last point, because I think it's a little bit of a thing.
sentences.zh: 但请允许我针对最后一点说几句，因为我觉得这有点小题大做。

sentences.en: Caitlin, I have to ask you this as a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，我必须以记者的身份问你这个。

sentences.en: What happens when you present a fellow journalist with incontrovertible information?
sentences.zh: 当你向同行记者出示无可辩驳的信息时会发生什么？

sentences.en: And say, this is in direct contradiction to something you have disseminated wildly.
sentences.zh: 并说，这与你大肆宣扬的某些内容直接矛盾。

sentences.en: And it is creating a false impression.
sentences.zh: 而且这正在造成一种错误的印象。

sentences.en: What does someone like Lee say to you?
sentences.zh: 像李这样的人会对你说什么？

sentences.en: Those conversations were really slippery.
sentences.zh: 那些对话真的很滑头。

sentences.en: They were really long.
sentences.zh: 真的持续了很久。

sentences.en: He's hard to pin down.
sentences.zh: 他很难被套出定论。

sentences.en: You know, you ask him one very specific question.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你问他一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Lee, what does any of it have to do with Twin Falls?
sentences.zh: 李，这跟双瀑镇有什么关系？

sentences.en: There are no Syrians in Twin Falls.
sentences.zh: 双瀑镇根本没有叙利亚人。

sentences.en: I mention it because I know those numbers offhand.
sentences.zh: 我提到这个是因为我对这些数字了如指掌。

sentences.en: I know, I can tell you what the Syrian, and by the way, there are Syrians coming to Twin Falls.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我可以告诉你叙利亚人……顺便说一句，确实有叙利亚人正来到双瀑镇。

sentences.en: I don't know how that's going to change.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这会有什么改变。

sentences.en: And then he sort of is like a pinball jumping back and forth.
sentences.zh: 然后他就有点像个弹球一样左右跳跃。

sentences.en: I'm making the details up here because I don't remember them.
sentences.zh: 我在这里编造细节，因为我记不清了。

sentences.en: But that the police were called three weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 但是警察在三周前就接到报警了。

sentences.en: A bunch of different topics that are sort of very loosely related to one another.
sentences.zh: 一堆彼此之间关系很松散的不同话题。

sentences.en: The Sufis are the people who dance at Grateful Dead concerts.
sentences.zh: 苏菲派是在感恩节大调应景音乐会上跳舞的人。

sentences.en: The Sunnis are the clitorectomies are a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 逊尼派则是指克托米切除术是不好的。

sentences.en: And I guess stoning women to death for committing adultery, which happens, is a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 我想因通奸而用石头砸死妇女这种事——虽然确实发生了——是不对的。

sentences.en: But what did come through to me was that he cares more, I think,
sentences.zh: 但真正传达到我心中的是，我觉得他更在乎，

sentences.en: about being able to say what it is that he wants to say and not being sort of censored than he does about getting it right.
sentences.zh: 能够说出自己想说的话而不被审查，而不是把事实搞对。

sentences.en: There is a correlation you're not supposed to talk about between Islamic refugees and rape.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰难民与强奸之间存在一种你不应该去谈论的关联。

sentences.en: And you can see this in Sweden.
sentences.zh: 你可以在瑞典看到这一点。

sentences.en: You can see this in Cologne.
sentences.zh: 你可以在科隆看到这一点。

sentences.en: And this was coming, you know, not long, you know, months after the Cologne thing, but when it was still fresh in a lot of people's memories.
sentences.zh: 而这发生在……你知道的，距离科隆事件没过多久，就在许多人记忆犹新的时候。

sentences.en: So that's when my email blew up.
sentences.zh: 所以那就是我的电子邮件炸锅的时候。

sentences.en: The mayor starts to receive a level of communication that he has never seen before in his life.
sentences.zh: 市长开始收到他一生中从未见过的海量信息。

sentences.en: I get up in the morning and I read my email with my coffee before I read the newspaper.
sentences.zh: 我早晨起来一边喝咖啡一边看电子邮件，然后才看报纸。

sentences.en: So when your email box from the night before is chock full of excellent work,
sentences.zh: 所以当你的收件箱里塞满了前一天晚上发来的“杰出工作”时，

sentences.en: allowing third world savages into your community and then allowing them to rape little girls and not investigate it.
sentences.zh: 允许第三世界的野蛮人进入你们的社区，然后让他们强奸小女孩却不进行调查。

sentences.en: The actual taxpayers are getting sick and tired of the government, failing them at every level.
sentences.zh: 真正的纳税人已经对政府在各个层面的失职感到厌烦透顶了。

sentences.en: He's getting emails almost every minute of the day.
sentences.zh: 他几乎每分钟都在收到电子邮件。

sentences.en: Police equals treason.
sentences.zh: 警察等于叛国。

sentences.en: Mayor equals treason.
sentences.zh: 市长等于叛国。

sentences.en: Council members equal treason.
sentences.zh: 议会议员等于叛国。

sentences.en: Cover up, totally worthless failures, the entire city council.
sentences.zh: 掩盖真相，完全是一群废物，整个市议会。

sentences.en: We will and are holding you responsible for any and all crimes committed by these, quote, refugees.
sentences.zh: 我们将并且正在追究你们对这些所谓的难民所犯下的任何及所有罪行的责任。

sentences.en: No courts, no police, just us.
sentences.zh: 没有法庭，没有警察，只有我们。

sentences.en: You will answer to us in the darkness of night.
sentences.zh: 你们将在夜色黑暗中接受我们的审判。

sentences.en: It was way bigger than I thought it was going to be.
sentences.zh: 这比我想象的要大得多。

sentences.en: And it was all about this sentiment that I didn't think was in my community.
sentences.zh: 这一切都围绕着这种情绪，而我以前认为我的社区里根本没有这种情绪。

sentences.en: Certainly not widespread.
sentences.zh: 当然更谈不上普遍存在。

sentences.en: And he's never experienced anything like this before.
sentences.zh: 而且他以前从未经历过这样的事情。

sentences.en: Remember, there was no fake news at this point in time.
sentences.zh: 记住，当时并没有假新闻这种说法。

sentences.en: That wasn't part of the common vernacular.
sentences.zh: 那还不是常用语的一部分。

sentences.en: And up until that point, you know, as far as most Americans are concerned, if you read something on a news story, it's real.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，你知道的，就大多数美国人而言，如果你在新闻报道中读到了某件事，那就是真的。

sentences.en: It happened.
sentences.zh: 那是发生过的。

sentences.en: And so he's seeing these stories pop up online.
sentences.zh: 所以他看到这些故事在网上不断冒出来。

sentences.en: He's seeing literally thousands of messages come into his phone and into his email inbox.
sentences.zh: 他看到成千上万的信息涌入他的手机和电子邮箱。

sentences.en: And he gets completely consumed by it.
sentences.zh: 他被这一切彻底吞噬了。

sentences.en: He stays up all night reading these messages.
sentences.zh: 他整夜不睡地阅读这些信息。

sentences.en: He says he was a wreck.
sentences.zh: 他说自己当时精神崩溃了。

sentences.en: He said it was hard to work.
sentences.zh: 他说工作都变得困难了。

sentences.en: And he really felt like, you know, he really felt like the whole country was following this story.
sentences.zh: 他真的觉得，你知道的，他真的觉得全国都在关注这个故事。

sentences.en: And the whole country thought that he was a corrupt, you know, colluding politician.
sentences.zh: 全国都认为他是一个腐败的、官商勾结的政客。

sentences.en: I stayed up late following the narrative down the rabbit hole.
sentences.zh: 我熬夜顺着叙事走向越陷越深。

sentences.en: I'd get up early, you know, worried about what emails did I get overnight and what's going to be in the paper this morning.
sentences.zh: 我很早就起床，你知道的，担心着夜里收到了什么邮件，今早报纸上又会登出什么内容。

sentences.en: I mean, it got in the way of me being able to do my mayor job, my chamber job, my chores at home, my being a good dad, my being a good husband.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这妨碍了我去履行市长职责、商会工作、家务劳动，妨碍了我做一个好父亲、好丈夫。

sentences.en: It consumed me.
sentences.zh: 我被它吞噬了。

sentences.en: And then his wife one day showed up at work and sat down and hit play on her voicemail.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，他的妻子来到办公室坐下，按下了语音留言的播放键。

sentences.en: I wonder, Ms. Barrett, and when you tried to scream, broke every tooth in your mouth.
sentences.zh: 我在想，巴雷特女士，当您试图尖叫时，嘴里的牙齿全被打碎了。

sentences.en: And then I wonder how you'd feel if when you went to the Twin Falls Police Department, they told you to run a law, that this is simply cultural diversity, don't you know?
sentences.zh: 然后我在想，如果您去双瀑镇警察局报案，他们却告诉您按法律办事，说这纯粹是文化多样性，您难道不知道吗，那时您会怎么想？

sentences.en: Recently, a woman, a member of parliament, Jo Cox, in England, who advocates the absolute inundation of her country with the lowest common denominator humanity has to offer,
sentences.zh: 最近，英国的一位女议员乔·克斯，她主张让其国家充斥着人性中最底层的一类人，即所谓的难民。

sentences.en: so-called refugees.
sentences.zh: 所谓的难民。

sentences.en: She met with opposition in the form of a bullet to the head.
sentences.zh: 她迎来的反对是一颗射向脑袋的子弹。

sentences.en: She's dead now.
sentences.zh: 她现在死了。

sentences.en: They buried her.
sentences.zh: 他们把她埋了。

sentences.en: Have a nice day.
sentences.zh: 祝您过得愉快。

sentences.en: Sorry, there are actually parts of this that are still a little difficult to talk about.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，实际上其中有些部分现在说起来还是觉得有点困难。

sentences.en: That, on a personal level, was probably the most, it was the scariest moment of this entire discussion.
sentences.zh: 从个人层面来看，这可能是最……这是整场风波中最让人害怕的时刻。

sentences.en: It gives you a sinking feeling to know that somebody somewhere took the time to find my phone number and leave me a voicemail.
sentences.zh: 得知某人在某处竟然花时间找出我的电话号码并给我留了语音，会让你有一种沉入谷底的感觉。

sentences.en: Beyond disheartening, it does strike a bit of fear into you.
sentences.zh: 这不仅令人沮丧，而且确实让人心生恐惧。

sentences.en: What's sort of ironic here is that the only time that the FBI and parts of the FBI that look into terrorism were involved in this case at all were as a result of these threats that came in to city officials from people who were concerned about terrorism to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这里有点讽刺的是，联邦调查局以及负责反恐的部门唯一一次介入这个案子，竟然是因为那些关心恐怖主义的人向市政官员发出了威胁。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is like, so these people who are afraid of terrorism end up taking up the tactics of terror.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，那些害怕恐怖主义的人最终却采用了恐怖主义的手段。

sentences.en: The tactics that they're afraid of, exactly.
sentences.zh: 他们所害怕的手段，正是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, these threats, I read hundreds of emails and listened to voicemails.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些威胁，我读了数百封邮件，听了语音留言。

sentences.en: They're incredibly graphic.
sentences.zh: 它们极其绘声绘色、不堪入目。

sentences.en: They talk about rape and mutilation and murder.
sentences.zh: 它们谈到了强奸、肢解和谋杀。

sentences.en: And it's all the same stuff that people were scared of is what they end up threatening to do.
sentences.zh: 这正是人们原本感到害怕的东西，而他们最终却威胁要做出这些事。

sentences.en: My name's Andy, and I'm here with The Times.
sentences.zh: 我叫安迪，我是《泰晤士报》的记者。

sentences.en: And I was going around asking people a little bit about their thoughts on the events that happened this summer.
sentences.zh: 我到处走访，想听听大家对今年夏天发生的事情有什么看法。

sentences.en: A producer I was with in Twin Falls went out and talked to people.
sentences.zh: 我和双瀑镇的一位制作人一起出去采访了当地人。

sentences.en: Is that what happened with the little girl?
sentences.zh: 小女孩那边是那样发生的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I've heard a girl was raped or molested by some illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 我听说有个女孩被几个非法移民强奸或猥亵了。

sentences.en: I heard that cops were covering for the refugees, not giving the full story, saying things didn't happen when they lied.
sentences.zh: 我听说警察在包庇难民，没有说出全部真相，事情明明发生了却说没发生。

sentences.en: The government is protecting them for whatever reason to make Obama's trying to look so great.
sentences.zh: 政府出于某种原因在保护他们，好让奥巴马看起来很伟大。

sentences.en: So he protects the refugees.
sentences.zh: 所以他保护难民。

sentences.en: I think, you know, personally, they should be castrated or I believe in the death penalty and what our laws should be, you know, juSt.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为，你知道的，他们应该被阉割，或者我相信死刑以及我们的法律应当是公正的。

sentences.en: And it's not.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: This feels like a larger truth about fake news in general, that once it's out in the world, it's virtually impossible to erase.
sentences.zh: 这让人觉得像是关于假新闻的一个更深层的真理：一旦它流传于世，就几乎不可能被抹去。

sentences.en: And I guess it's important to remember that so many of these stories by people like Lee Stranahan, they were designed to play on people's pre-existing anxieties and angers.
sentences.zh: 我想重要的是要记住，像李·斯特拉纳汉这样的人发表的许多此类报道，都是为了利用人们原本就存在的焦虑和愤怒。

sentences.en: And so it might be especially hard to roll those back.
sentences.zh: 所以要扭转这些影响可能会格外困难。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I think that Lee sees his audience first and foremost as people who he describes have reasonable fears and questions about Islam, for example,
sentences.zh: 我认为李把他的受众首先视为这样一群人：例如，他们对伊斯兰教抱有合理的恐惧和疑问，

sentences.en: because they don't know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 因为他们对伊斯兰教一无所知。

sentences.en: But the answers that he gives them are the scariest possible interpretation of the facts, the worst case scenario, that your nightmare is coming true.
sentences.zh: 但他给他们的答案却是对事实最可怕的解读、最坏的情况，即你的噩梦正在变成现实。

sentences.en: And that's really hard to get out of people's minds entirely once they've been told that in a really visceral, real way.
sentences.zh: 一旦人们以一种非常直观、真实的方式被灌输了这些，就很难再把它们完全从脑海中驱散了。

sentences.en: Kaelin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 凯琳，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, The Times reported that President Trump plans to cap refugee admissions for next year at 45,000,
sentences.zh: 周二，《泰晤士报》报道称，特朗普总统计划将明年的难民接纳上限设定为4.5万人，

sentences.en: setting a historically low limit on the number of people who can resettle in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对可以重新安置到美国的难民人数设定了历史最低上限

sentences.en: after fleeing persecution in their own countries.
sentences.zh: 这些难民此前为了逃离本国的迫害而背井离乡。

sentences.en: The limit is the lowest any White House has sought since 1980, the year legislation was enacted giving the president a role in determining a cap on refugees.
sentences.zh: 这一上限是1980年以来白宫设定的最低水平，当年颁布的法律赋予了总统决定难民上限的权力。

sentences.en: The cap has never gone lower than 67,000, the number Ronald Reagan said in 1986.
sentences.zh: 这一上限从未低于67,000人，即罗纳德·里根在1986年确定的数字。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 即使在当年黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里做DJ，你每天晚上也要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在即可在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅用户，今天就下载《时报》应用，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell has officially abandoned the Republicans' latest effort to repeal and replace the Affordable Care Act,
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔已正式放弃共和党废除并取代《平价医疗法案》的最新努力，

sentences.en: conceding that his party does not have the votes.
sentences.zh: 他承认本党没有足够的票数。

sentences.en: We haven't given up on changing the American health care system.
sentences.zh: 我们并未放弃改变美国医疗保健系统的努力。

sentences.en: We are not going to be able to do that this week.
sentences.zh: 我们本周无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: But it still lies ahead of us, and we haven't given up on that.
sentences.zh: 但它依然摆在我们面前，我们并未放弃。

sentences.en: McConnell says Republicans will now move on to their next big legislative priority, the same one they had planned to turn to back in July, when the skinny repeal vote failed,
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔表示，共和党人现在将转向下一个重大的立法优先事项，这与他们在7月份精简版废除法案投票失败时计划转向的优先事项相同，

sentences.en: overhauling the tax code, a task Congress has not accomplished since 1986.
sentences.zh: 即彻底改革税法，这是国会自1986年以来一直未完成的任务。

sentences.en: And President Trump says Puerto Rico has been, quote, literally destroyed by Hurricane Maria and is vowing to visit the island next week,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，波多黎各被飓风“玛丽亚”字面意义上“彻底摧毁”，并誓言将于下周访问该岛，

sentences.en: as criticism grows that his administration has failed to adequately respond to the crisis there.
sentences.zh: 此前外界批评他的政府未能对当地危机做出充分反应的声音日益高涨。

sentences.en: And it's the most difficult job because it's on the island.
sentences.zh: 而且这是最困难的工作，因为它在岛上。

sentences.en: It's on an island in the middle of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 它在海洋中央的一个岛屿上。

sentences.en: It's out in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 它孤悬海外。

sentences.en: You can't just drive your trucks there from other states.
sentences.zh: 你不能直接从其他州把卡车开过去。

sentences.en: And the governor said we are doing a great job.
sentences.zh: 州长说我们干得非常棒。

sentences.en: In fact, he thanked me specifically for FEMA and all of the first responders in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他特别感谢我为波多黎各的联邦紧急事务管理局和所有急救人员所做的工作。

sentences.en: Puerto Rico's governor, Ricardo Rossello, says the country is on the brink of a humanitarian crisis and is pleading with the White House for help.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各州长里卡多·罗塞略表示，该国正处于人道主义危机的边缘，并向白宫恳求帮助。

sentences.en: Recognize that we Puerto Ricans are American citizens, he said.
sentences.zh: 他指出，请认识到我们波多黎各人是美国公民。

sentences.en: When we speak of a catastrophe, everyone must be treated equally.
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论灾难时，每个人都必须受到平等的对待。

sentences.en: I will be going to Puerto Rico on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我将于周二前往波多黎各。

sentences.en: Today, I'll also be going to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，我还将前往美国

sentences.en: Virgin Islands.
sentences.zh: 维尔京群岛。

sentences.en: Over the last several weeks, our nation has been tested by the destructive force of Mother Nature.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，我们的国家经受了大自然破坏力的考验。

sentences.en: But we will respond to it with an even mightier force, the resolve of the American spirit.
sentences.zh: 但我们将以更强大的力量去应对，那就是美国精神的决心。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时甚至扣人心弦的权力斗争之中。
